author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Fortnite now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6001a60f9 

The Simpsons are crashing the party again, and this time, they're bringing the chaos straight to Reload. Springfield is back on the map rotation with a few fresh tweaks, plus a brand-new location, The Confidential! The new map now holds 50 players, so expect to fight a lot more enemies.  

Look who showed up! John Wick and Homer NPCs will wait for you on Starter Island. Don't forget to track down Moe over in The Confidential! 

#Fortnite
